# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide.csv")
data_long_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long_ml.csv")
data_wide_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide_ml.csv")
```

# Figure 6

## Figure 6A

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint == "Baseline") |> 
  filter(Disease %in% c("HIV")) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Subgroup", 
                          case = "Elite controller", 
                          control = c("Primary HIV infection", "More preserved immunity", "Severely impaired immunity"), 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 5,
                  top_down_prot = 10,
                  title = "Elite controllers (at baseline) vs. PLWH (at baseline)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_ec_baseline_hiv <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_ec_hiv_ba <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot EC vs HIV baseline.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot EC vs HIV baseline.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

## Figure 6B

```{r}

                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

                          variable = "Subgroup",

                          control = c("Primary HIV infection"), 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 5,
                  top_down_prot = 10,
                  title = "Elite controllers (at baseline) vs. Primary HIV infection (at baseline)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_ec_primary_ba <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),

p

p_volcano_ec_primary_ba <- p

  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

  filename = "Volcano plot EC vs primary baseline.png",
```

## Figure 6I

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Treatment %in% "INSTI + Abacavir" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" | Subgroup == "Elite controller" & Timepoint == "Follow-up") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (follow-up)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (follow-up)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint)) |>
  mutate(Comparison = case_when(Treatment == "Untreated" ~ "case",
                                    TRUE ~ "control"))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Comparison", 
                          case = "case", 
                          control = "control", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")
                          ) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "Elite controllers (at follow-up) vs. INSTI + Abacavir (at follow-up)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_instiaa_fu_ec <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_instiaa_fu_ec <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot insti fu ec.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot insti fu ec.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

```{r}
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (follow-up)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (follow-up)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint)) |>
  mutate(Comparison = case_when(Treatment == "Untreated" ~ "case",
                                    TRUE ~ "control"))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Comparison", 
                          case = "case", 
                          control = "control", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex")
                          ) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = "Elite controllers (at follow-up) vs. NNRTI + Tenofovir (at follow-up)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_nnrtite_fu_ec <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_nnrtite_fu_ec <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot NNRTI + Tenofovir fu ec.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot NNRTI + Tenofovir fu ec.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

set.seed(12345)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Settings
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Put Figure 6 DE results into named list
# --------------------------------------------------

de_list_fig6 <- list(
  "EC baseline vs PLWH baseline" =
    res_ec_baseline_hiv,

  "EC baseline vs PHI baseline" =
    res_ec_primary_ba,

  "EC baseline vs SII baseline" =
    res_ec_impaired_ba,
  
  "EC baeline vs MPI baseline" =
    res_ec_preserved_ba,

  "EC follow-up vs PLWH follow-up" =
    res_ec_hiv_fu,

  "EC follow-up vs PHI follow-up" =
    res_ec_primary_fu,

  "EC follow-up vs MPI follow-up" =
    res_ec_preserved_fu,

  "EC follow-up vs SII follow-up" =
    res_ec_impaired_fu,

  "EC follow-up vs INSTI + Abacavir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_ec,

  "EC follow-up vs INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_ec,

  "EC follow-up vs NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_nnrtite_fu_ec
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create edge table
# --------------------------------------------------

cnet_edges_fig6 <- imap_dfr(de_list_fig6, function(df, comparison_name) {

  df |>
    filter(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Comparison = comparison_name,
      Direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~ "Higher in EC",
        logFC < 0 ~ "Lower in EC"
      ),
      abs_logFC = abs(logFC)
    ) |>
    select(
      Comparison,
      Feature,
      logFC,
      abs_logFC,
      P.Value,
      adj.P.Val,
      Direction
    )
})

# Sanity check
cnet_edges_fig6 |> count(Comparison, Direction)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Optional: keep only proteins significant in >= 2 comparisons
# --------------------------------------------------
# Set min_comparisons <- 1 if you want all significant proteins.

min_comparisons <- 1

keep_proteins <- cnet_edges_fig6 |>
  count(Feature, name = "n_comparisons") |>
  filter(n_comparisons >= min_comparisons) |>
  pull(Feature)

cnet_edges_plot <- cnet_edges_fig6 |>
  filter(Feature %in% keep_proteins)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create nodes
# --------------------------------------------------

comparison_nodes <- tibble(
  name = names(de_list_fig6),
  type = "Comparison",
  n_comparisons = NA_integer_
)

protein_nodes <- cnet_edges_plot |>
  count(Feature, name = "n_comparisons") |>
  transmute(
    name = Feature,
    type = "Protein",
    n_comparisons = n_comparisons
  )

nodes_fig6 <- bind_rows(
  comparison_nodes,
  protein_nodes
) |>
  filter(name %in% c(cnet_edges_plot$Comparison, cnet_edges_plot$Feature)) |>
  mutate(
    node_size = case_when(
      type == "Comparison" ~ 6,
      type == "Protein" ~ 2 + n_comparisons
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Build graph
# --------------------------------------------------

graph_edges_fig6 <- cnet_edges_plot |>
  transmute(
    from = Comparison,
    to = Feature,
    logFC,
    abs_logFC,
    adj.P.Val,
    Direction
  )

g_fig6 <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = graph_edges_fig6,
  vertices = nodes_fig6,
  directed = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot network
# --------------------------------------------------

p_cnet_fig6 <- ggraph(g_fig6, layout = "fr") +

  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      color = Direction,
      width = abs_logFC
    ),
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +

  geom_node_point(
    aes(
      shape = type,
      size = node_size,
      fill = type
    ),
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3.4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  scale_edge_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Higher in EC" = "#C03830",
      "Lower in EC"  = "#317EC2"
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Comparison" = "white",
      "Protein" = "grey90"
    )
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Comparison" = 22,
      "Protein" = 21
    )
  ) +

  scale_edge_width(
    range = c(0.4, 2.3),
    name = "|logFC|"
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 9),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Differentially abundant proteins in Elite controller comparisons",
    edge_color = "Direction",
    shape = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_cnet_fig6

dir.create("../plots/pdf/network", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/network", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(12345)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Settings
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5
min_comparisons <- 1   # change to 2+ if you want stricter filtering

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. DE list
# --------------------------------------------------

de_list_fig6 <- list(
  "EC vs PLWH (baseline)" = res_ec_baseline_hiv,
  "EC vs PHI (baseline)"  = res_ec_primary_ba,
  "EC vs SII (baseline)"  = res_ec_impaired_ba,
  "EC vs MPI (baseline)"  = res_ec_preserved_ba,

  "EC vs PLWH (follow-up)" = res_ec_hiv_fu,
  "EC vs PHI (follow-up)"  = res_ec_primary_fu,
  "EC vs MPI (follow-up)"  = res_ec_preserved_fu,
  "EC vs SII (follow-up)"  = res_ec_impaired_fu,

  "EC vs INSTI + Abacavir"   = res_instiaa_fu_ec,
  "EC vs INSTI + Tenofovir"  = res_instite_fu_ec,
  "EC vs NNRTI + Tenofovir"  = res_nnrtite_fu_ec
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Combine DE results
# --------------------------------------------------

df_all <- imap_dfr(de_list_fig6, function(df, comparison_name) {
  df |>
    mutate(Comparison = comparison_name) |>
    select(Comparison, Feature, logFC, adj.P.Val)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Filter significant proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

df_sig <- df_all |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff)

# Keep proteins appearing in ≥ min_comparisons
keep_proteins <- df_sig |>
  count(Feature) |>
  filter(n >= min_comparisons) |>
  pull(Feature)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare plotting dataset
# --------------------------------------------------

df_plot <- df_all |>
  filter(Feature %in% keep_proteins) |>
  mutate(
    logFC_plot = ifelse(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff,
      logFC,
      NA
    ),
    size_plot = ifelse(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      -log10(adj.P.Val),
      NA
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Order proteins (strongest signal first)
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_order <- df_plot |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(max_fc = max(abs(logFC_plot), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(max_fc)) |>
  pull(Feature)

df_plot <- df_plot |>
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = feature_order),
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = names(de_list_fig6))
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot bubble heatmap
# --------------------------------------------------

p_bubble_fig6 <- ggplot(
  df_plot,
  aes(x = Comparison, y = Feature)
) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = size_plot,
      fill = logFC_plot
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#317EC2",   # lower in EC
    mid = "white",
    high = "#C03830",  # higher in EC
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "logFC"
  ) +
  
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = expression(-log[10]("adj.P.Val")),
    range = c(2, 8)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Differentially abundant proteins in Elite controller comparisons",
    x = "Comparison",
    y = "Protein"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_bubble_fig6

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

dir.create("../plots/pdf/bubble", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/bubble", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/bubble/bubble_elite_controller_comparisons.pdf",
  p_bubble_fig6,
  width = 14,
  height = 30
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/bubble/bubble_elite_controller_comparisons.png",
  p_bubble_fig6,
  width = 14,
  height = 30,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# 1. Settings
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05

  "EC vs MPI (baseline)"  = res_ec_preserved_ba,

  "EC vs PLWH (follow-up)" = res_ec_hiv_fu,
  "EC vs PHI (follow-up)"  = res_ec_primary_fu,
  "EC vs MPI (follow-up)"  = res_ec_preserved_fu,
  "EC vs SII (follow-up)"  = res_ec_impaired_fu,

  "EC vs INSTI + Abacavir"   = res_instiaa_fu_ec,
  "EC vs INSTI + Tenofovir"  = res_instite_fu_ec,
  "EC vs NNRTI + Tenofovir"  = res_nnrtite_fu_ec
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Combine DE results
# --------------------------------------------------

df_all <- imap_dfr(de_list_fig6, function(df, comparison_name) {
  df |>
    mutate(Comparison = comparison_name) |>
    select(Comparison, Feature, logFC, adj.P.Val)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Filter significant proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

df_sig <- df_all |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff)

keep_proteins <- df_sig |>
  count(Feature) |>
  filter(n >= min_comparisons) |>
  pull(Feature)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare plotting dataset
# --------------------------------------------------

      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff & abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff,

    ),
    size_plot = ifelse(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      -log10(adj.P.Val),
      NA
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. NEW ORDER: by shared significance
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_order <- df_plot |>

  pull(Feature)

df_plot <- df_plot |>
```

#### Experiment

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define EC reference (baseline)
# --------------------------------------------------

ec_ref <- data_wide |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Elite controller", Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  select(-DAid, -ID, -Subgroup, -Timepoint) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compute distance to EC
# --------------------------------------------------

compute_distance <- function(x, ref) {
  sqrt(sum((x - ref)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

df_dist <- data_wide |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    distance_to_EC = compute_distance(
      c_across(where(is.numeric)),
      as.numeric(ec_ref)
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot trajectories
# --------------------------------------------------

p_traj <- df_dist |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(distance_to_EC), group = ID, color = Subgroup)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Subgroup),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trajectory toward Elite Controller proteomic state",
    y = "Distance to EC (proteome)",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_traj
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(12345)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Settings
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5
min_comparisons <- 1

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Function for cnet-style plot
# --------------------------------------------------

make_ec_cnet_plot <- function(de_list,
                              title,
                              fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
                              logfc_cutoff = 0.5,
                              min_comparisons = 1) {

  cnet_edges <- imap_dfr(de_list, function(df, comparison_name) {

    df |>
      filter(
        adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
        abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff
      ) |>
      mutate(
        Comparison = comparison_name,
        Direction = case_when(
          logFC > 0 ~ "Higher in EC",
          logFC < 0 ~ "Lower in EC"
        ),
        abs_logFC = abs(logFC)
      ) |>
      select(
        Comparison,
        Feature,
        logFC,
        abs_logFC,
        P.Value,
        adj.P.Val,
        Direction
      )
  })

  if (nrow(cnet_edges) == 0) {
    stop("No significant proteins found with the selected thresholds.")
  }

  keep_proteins <- cnet_edges |>
    count(Feature, name = "n_comparisons") |>
    filter(n_comparisons >= min_comparisons) |>
    pull(Feature)

  cnet_edges_plot <- cnet_edges |>
    filter(Feature %in% keep_proteins)

  comparison_nodes <- tibble(
    name = names(de_list),
    type = "Comparison",
    n_comparisons = NA_integer_
  )

  protein_nodes <- cnet_edges_plot |>
    count(Feature, name = "n_comparisons") |>
    transmute(
      name = Feature,
      type = "Protein",
      n_comparisons = n_comparisons
    )

  nodes <- bind_rows(comparison_nodes, protein_nodes) |>
    filter(name %in% c(cnet_edges_plot$Comparison, cnet_edges_plot$Feature)) |>
    mutate(
      node_size = case_when(
        type == "Comparison" ~ 6,
        type == "Protein" ~ 2 + n_comparisons
      )
    )

  graph_edges <- cnet_edges_plot |>
    transmute(
      from = Comparison,
      to = Feature,
      logFC,
      abs_logFC,
      adj.P.Val,
      Direction
    )

  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    d = graph_edges,
    vertices = nodes,
    directed = FALSE
  )

  p <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        color = Direction,
        width = abs_logFC
      ),
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      aes(
        shape = type,
        size = node_size,
        fill = type
      ),
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name),
      repel = TRUE,
      size = 3.4,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Higher in EC" = "#C03830",
        "Lower in EC"  = "#317EC2"
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Comparison" = "white",
        "Protein" = "grey90"
      )
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Comparison" = 22,
        "Protein" = 21
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.4, 2.3),
      name = "|logFC|"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(3, 9),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      edge_color = "Direction",
      shape = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 16,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  return(p)
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Baseline DE result list
# --------------------------------------------------

de_list_baseline <- list(
  "EC vs PLWH" =
    res_ec_baseline_hiv,

  "EC vs PHI" =
    res_ec_primary_ba,

  "EC vs MPI" =
    res_ec_preserved_ba,

  "EC vs SII" =
    res_ec_impaired_ba
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Follow-up DE result list
# --------------------------------------------------

de_list_followup <- list(
  "EC vs PLWH" =
    res_ec_hiv_fu,

  "EC vs PHI" =
    res_ec_primary_fu,

  "EC vs MPI" =
    res_ec_preserved_fu,

  "EC vs SII" =
    res_ec_impaired_fu,

  "EC vs INSTI + Abacavir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_ec,

  "EC vs INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_ec,

  "EC vs NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_nnrtite_fu_ec
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Generate plots
# --------------------------------------------------

p_cnet_baseline <- make_ec_cnet_plot(
  de_list = de_list_baseline,
  title = "Differentially abundant proteins in Elite controller comparisons at baseline",
  fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff,
  logfc_cutoff = logfc_cutoff,
  min_comparisons = min_comparisons
)

p_cnet_followup <- make_ec_cnet_plot(
  de_list = de_list_followup,
  title = "Differentially abundant proteins in Elite controller comparisons at follow-up",
  fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff,
  logfc_cutoff = logfc_cutoff,

)

p_cnet_baseline
p_cnet_followup
```

```{r}
p
```

### Treatment trajectories

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==================================================
# 1. Define treatments
# ==================================================

treatment_keep <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir"
)

# ==================================================
# 2. Prepare PCA input
# ==================================================

input_df <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(
    DAid %in% (
      metadata |>
        filter(
          Treatment %in% c(treatment_keep, "Untreated") |
          Subgroup == "Elite controller"
        ) |>
        pull(DAid)
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# 3. PCA
# ==================================================

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

# ==================================================
# 4. Merge metadata + define groups
# ==================================================

pca_plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  mutate(
    ID = as.factor(ID),

    Subgroup = factor(
      Subgroup,
      levels = c(
        "Primary HIV infection",
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Elite controller"
      )
    ),

    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up")),

    # Ellipse groups
    Ellipse_group = case_when(
      Treatment %in% treatment_keep & Timepoint == "Baseline"  ~ "Treated baseline",
      Treatment %in% treatment_keep & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Treated follow-up",
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" & Timepoint == "Baseline"  ~ "Untreated baseline",
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Untreated follow-up"
    ),

    # Point colors
    Color_group = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" & Timepoint == "Baseline"  ~ "EC baseline",
      Subgroup == "Elite controller" & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "EC follow-up",
      TRUE & Timepoint == "Baseline"  ~ "Treated baseline",
      TRUE & Timepoint == "Follow-up" ~ "Treated follow-up"
    )
  )

# ==================================================
# 5. PCA panel function
# ==================================================

make_pca_panel <- function(treatment_name) {
  
  df_sub <- pca_plot_df |>
    filter(
      Treatment == treatment_name |
      Subgroup == "Elite controller"
    )
  
  ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    
    # --- trajectories ---
    geom_line(
      aes(group = ID),
      color = "grey70",
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    
    # --- filled ellipses ---
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(fill = Ellipse_group),
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.15,
      color = NA
    ) +
    
    # --- dashed ellipse outlines ---
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(color = Ellipse_group),
      linewidth = 1.2,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    
    # --- POINTS (FIXED) ---
    geom_point(
      aes(
        shape = Subgroup,
        fill  = Color_group
      ),
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    
    # --- axes ---
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-40, 45),
      ylim = c(-35, 20)
    ) +
    
    # --- ellipse colors ---
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Treated baseline"  = "steelblue",
        "Treated follow-up" = "firebrick",
        "Untreated baseline"  = "darkgreen",
        "Untreated follow-up" = "lightgreen"
      )
    ) +
    
    # --- POINT COLORS (UPDATED) ---
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Treated baseline" = "steelblue",
        "Treated follow-up" = "firebrick",
        "EC baseline" = "darkgreen",
        "EC follow-up" = "lightgreen"
      )
    ) +
    
    # --- FILLABLE SHAPES ---
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "Primary HIV infection"      = 21,
        "More preserved immunity"    = 24,
        "Severely impaired immunity" = 22,
        "Elite controller"           = 23
      )
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = treatment_name,
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
      fill  = "Sample type",
      color = "Ellipse group"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==================================================
# 6. Create panels
# ==================================================

p1 <- make_pca_panel("INSTI + Abacavir")
p2 <- make_pca_panel("INSTI + Tenofovir")
p3 <- make_pca_panel("NNRTI + Tenofovir")

# ==================================================
# 7. Combine
# ==================================================

plot_final <- (p1 | p2 | p3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Trajectory in PCA space relative to Elite Controllers",
    subtitle = "Colored by treatment vs EC and timepoint",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  ) &
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

plot_final

# ==================================================
# 8. Save
# ==================================================

dir.create("../plots/pdf/pca", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/pca", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/pca/pca_trajectory_per_treatment_fixed_colors.pdf",
  plot_final,
  width = 20,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/pca/pca_trajectory_per_treatment_fixed_colors.png",
  plot_final,
  width = 14,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Boxplot changes

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# ==================================================
# 1. Treatments
# ==================================================

treatment_keep <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir"
)

treatment_colors <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir"  = "#FDB462",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir" = "#80B1D3",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir" = "#B3DE69"
)

# ==================================================
# 2. Baseline treatment per ID
# ==================================================

treatment_baseline <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  select(ID, Treatment_baseline = Treatment)

# ==================================================
# 3. Build proteomics matrix
# ==================================================

mat_df <- data_wide |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  select(DAid, where(is.numeric)) |>
  distinct(DAid, .keep_all = TRUE)

mat <- mat_df |>
  column_to_rownames("DAid") |>
  as.matrix()

# ==================================================
# 4. Remove problematic proteins (CRITICAL)
# ==================================================

# Remove near-zero variance
sd_cols <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
mat <- mat[, sd_cols > 1e-6]

# Remove columns with too many NA
na_fraction <- colMeans(is.na(mat))
mat <- mat[, na_fraction < 0.5]

# ==================================================
# 5. Z-score scaling
# ==================================================

mat_scaled <- scale(mat)

# Remove columns that became NA/Inf after scaling
valid_cols <- apply(mat_scaled, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))
mat_scaled <- mat_scaled[, valid_cols]

# ==================================================
# 6. PCA
# ==================================================

pca <- prcomp(mat_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# Choose PCs (adjust if needed)
n_pc <- 15

pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:n_pc]) |>
  rownames_to_column("DAid")

# ==================================================
# 7. EC reference (baseline)
# ==================================================

ec_ids <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Subgroup == "Elite controller",
    Timepoint == "Baseline"
  ) |>
  pull(DAid)

ec_ref <- pc_scores |>
  filter(DAid %in% ec_ids) |>
  summarise(across(starts_with("PC"), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  as.numeric()

# ==================================================
# 8. Compute PCA-based distance
# ==================================================

df_dist <- pc_scores |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  inner_join(treatment_baseline, by = "ID") |>
  filter(Treatment_baseline %in% treatment_keep) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    distance_to_EC = sqrt(
      sum((c_across(starts_with("PC")) - ec_ref)^2)
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# ==================================================
# 9. Keep paired individuals
# ==================================================

df_paired <- df_dist |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  filter(n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up")),
    Treatment_baseline = factor(Treatment_baseline, levels = treatment_keep)
  )

# ==================================================
# 10. Plot (FINAL STYLE)
# ==================================================

p <- ggplot(
  df_paired,
  aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(distance_to_EC))
) +
  
  # Paired lines
  geom_line(
    aes(group = ID),
    color = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Treatment_baseline),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Treatment_baseline, nrow = 1) +
  
  labs(
    title = "PCA-based distance to Elite Controllers",
    subtitle = "Each line represents one individual",
    y = "log10 distance to EC (PCA space)",
    x = ""
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p

# ==================================================
# 11. Save
# ==================================================

dir.create("../plots/pdf/trajectory", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots/png/trajectory", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/trajectory/ec_distance_pca.pdf",
  p,
  width = 12,
  height = 4
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/trajectory/ec_distance_pca.png",
  p,
  width = 12,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

### Boxplot delta

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ==================================================
# 1. Compute delta distance
# ==================================================

df_delta <- df_paired |>
  select(ID, Timepoint, Treatment_baseline, distance_to_EC) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = distance_to_EC
  ) |>
  mutate(
    delta_distance = `Follow-up` - Baseline
  )

# ==================================================
# 2. Plot Δ distance
# ==================================================

p_delta <- ggplot(
  df_delta,
  aes(x = Treatment_baseline, y = delta_distance)
) +
  
  # Boxplot (clean style)
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment_baseline),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # Reference line (no change)
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Change in distance to Elite Controllers",
    subtitle = "Follow-up − Baseline (negative = more EC-like)",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Δ distance to EC (PCA space)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_delta

# ==================================================
# 3. Save
# ==================================================

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/trajectory/ec_delta_distance.pdf",
  p_delta,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/trajectory/ec_delta_distance.png",
  p_delta,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ==================================================
# 1. Compute delta distance
# ==================================================

df_delta <- df_paired |>
  select(ID, Timepoint, Treatment_baseline, Subgroup, distance_to_EC) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = distance_to_EC
  ) |>
  mutate(
    delta_distance = `Follow-up` - Baseline
  )

# ==================================================
# 2. Add ΔCD4/CD8 (from metadata)
# ==================================================

df_delta <- df_delta |>
  left_join(
    metadata |>
      filter(Timepoint == "Follow-up") |>   # delta is typically defined here
      select(ID, `Delta CD4/CD8`),
    by = "ID"
  ) |>
  rename(delta_cd4cd8 = `Delta CD4/CD8`)

# ==================================================
# 3. Define shapes
# ==================================================

shape_values <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"      = 16,
  "More preserved immunity"    = 17,
  "Severely impaired immunity" = 15,
  "Elite controller"           = 18
)

# ==================================================
# 4. Plot Δ distance
# ==================================================

p_delta <- ggplot(
  df_delta,
  aes(x = Treatment_baseline, y = delta_distance)
) +
  
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points (UPDATED)
  geom_jitter(
    aes(
      shape = Subgroup,
      color = delta_cd4cd8
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # Reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  
  # 🔥 Continuous biological gradient
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#317EC2",   # negative change
    mid = "white",
    high = "#C03830",  # positive change
    midpoint = 0.5,
    name = "Δ CD4/CD8"
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_values) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Change in distance to Elite Controllers",
    subtitle = "Follow-up − Baseline (negative = more EC-like)",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Δ distance to EC (PCA space)",
    shape = "HIV-1 subgroup"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_delta

# ==================================================
# 5. Save
# ==================================================

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/trajectory/ec_delta_distance.pdf",
  p_delta,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/trajectory/ec_delta_distance.png",
  p_delta,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ==================================================
# 1. Compute delta distance

df_delta <- df_paired |>
  select(ID, Timepoint, Treatment_baseline, Subgroup, distance_to_EC) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = distance_to_EC
  ) |>
  mutate(

  )

# ==================================================
# 2. Define shapes + colors

)

)
```

### Boxplots

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0. Libraries
# ==================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ==================================================
# 1. DEFINE COLORS (🔥 ALL INCLUDED)
# ==================================================

treatment_colors <- c(
  "INSTI + Tenofovir" = "#80B1D3",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"  = "#FDB462",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir" = "#B3DE69"
)

Subgroup_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"       = "#4B988F",
  "Severely impaired immunity"  = "#EABBBB",
  "More preserved immunity"     = "#C89A1B",
  "Elite controller"            = "#5A588B"
)

healthy <- "#CCCCCC"

# 🔥 FINAL palette
final_colors <- c(
  treatment_colors,
  Subgroup_colors,
  "Healthy" = healthy
)

# ==================================================
# 2. PROTEINS
# ==================================================

highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "CSF3",
  "RBP2",
  "CLEC10A",
  "DKK4",
  "SCGN",
  "CKMT1A_CKMT1B"
)

# ==================================================
# 3. GROUP DEFINITIONS
# ==================================================

treatment_order <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir"
)

Subgroup_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity"
)

# ==================================================
# 4. BASE DATA
# ==================================================

base_df <- data_long |>
  select(DAid, Feature, NPX) |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  filter(Feature %in% highlighted_proteins)

# ==================================================
# 5. BUILD GROUPS
# ==================================================

df_treatment <- base_df |>
  filter(Treatment %in% treatment_order) |>
  mutate(
    Group_time  = paste(Treatment, Timepoint, sep = " – "),
    Group_color = Treatment
  )

df_subgroup <- base_df |>
  filter(Subgroup %in% Subgroup_order) |>
  mutate(
    Group_time  = paste(Subgroup, Timepoint, sep = " – "),
    Group_color = Subgroup
  )

df_elite <- base_df |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Elite controller") |>
  mutate(
    Group_time  = paste("Elite controller", Timepoint, sep = " – "),
    Group_color = "Elite controller"
  )

df_healthy <- base_df |>
  filter(Subgroup == "Healthy") |>
  mutate(
    Group_time  = "Healthy",
    Group_color = "Healthy"
  )

# ==================================================
# 6. COMBINE
# ==================================================

p_up <- bind_rows(
  df_treatment,
  df_subgroup,
  df_elite,
  df_healthy
) |>
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Group_color = factor(Group_color, levels = names(final_colors))
  )

# ==================================================
# 7. X-AXIS ORDER
# ==================================================

x_order <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",

  "Primary HIV infection – Baseline",
  "Primary HIV infection – Follow-up",
  "More preserved immunity – Baseline",
  "More preserved immunity – Follow-up",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Baseline",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Follow-up",

  "Elite controller – Baseline",
  "Elite controller – Follow-up",

  "Healthy"
)

p_up$Group_time <- factor(p_up$Group_time, levels = x_order)

# ==================================================
# 8. PLOT
# ==================================================

p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(x = Group_time, y = NPX, group = Group_time)
) +
  
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = Group_color),
    alpha  = 0.7,
    width  = 0.25,
    size   = 2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Group_color),
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = final_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = final_colors) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    subtitle = "Treatments, HIV subgroups, Elite controllers (baseline/follow-up), and Healthy",
    x = "Group / Timepoint",
    y = "NPX"
  )

p_up_plot

# ==================================================
# 9. SAVE
# ==================================================

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_correct_palette.pdf",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 9,
  height   = 16
)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_correct_palette.png",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 9,
  height   = 16,
  dpi      = 300
)
```
